احترسوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَرَسُوا (iḥtarasū) /iħ.ta.ra.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَرَسَ (iḥtarasa)
# اِحْتَرِسُوا (iḥtarisū) /iħ.ta.ri.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَرَسَ (iḥtarasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
